objective: Let a local product owner approve one immutable implementation brief with explicit acceptance criteria for one prioritized Product Issue while preserving exact Feedback, Signal, and Product Issue lineage.
scope: Add the Implementation Briefs bounded context and issue-to-brief workflow.
Create at most one immutable brief for an existing Product Issue in a locked PostgreSQL transaction.
Persist a bounded objective, one to ten bounded acceptance criteria, zero to ten bounded constraints, an unverified local approver label, and server approval time.
Add POST /api/v1/product-issues/{productIssueId}/implementation-brief and an additive implementationBrief Signal-detail projection.
Expose owner approval, persisted acceptance criteria, and full source lineage through the local product interface.
Apply existing acknowledgement, input-bound, restricted-content, privacy, and fail-closed storage rules.
Produce ordered Foundation, Component, Integration, Workflow, and Stress evidence without advancing past a failed level.
Measure Elder and direct-human intervention, correct at most one reproduced Elder blocker, replay it, write a handoff, and stop.
non_goals: Brief editing, deletion, versioning, task breakdown, assignment, implementation status, verification status, release notes, or customer communication.
Probabilistic inference, automatic acceptance criteria, autonomous implementation, or autonomous pull-request creation.
Authentication, authorization, verified identity, tenancy, shared hosting, staging, production, deployment, merge, or release.
SD-004, Gate G continuation, L2 or L3 promotion, or more than one Elder correction.
session_boundary: Stop after SD-003 product verification, retrospective, at most one reproduced Elder correction and replay, session close, and handoff at the Git authorization boundary; do not begin another slice, phase, gate, merge, or deployment.
evidence_plan: Foundation: validate the SD-003 ADR, contract, work item, Prisma schema, migration, source layout, dependency boundaries, types, lint, and closed route surface.
Component: prove deterministic brief normalization, acknowledgement, array and text bounds, restricted-content rejection, and generated identity and time binding.
Integration: prove source Product Issue locking, one immutable brief per Product Issue, exact lineage, duplicate and concurrent rejection, and PostgreSQL constraints.
Workflow: use only the local UI to create and accept a Signal, promote it, approve its brief, inspect acceptance criteria and lineage, reload, and observe persistence at desktop and mobile widths.
Stress: prove concurrent brief creation has one winner, missing and duplicate creation fail closed, database outage and recovery are explicit, and submitted brief content is absent from logs.
Factory: record Elder activation, admission/readiness truth, direct Codex and human intervention, one reproduced blocker at most, its correction and replay, and the remaining authorization boundary.
